sessions.topic: Certifying coverage over continuous adoption mechanisms
sessions.boundary_reason: The certification audit concludes, and attention turns to clustered and hub-dominated networks.

sessions.topic: Hub-network coverage failure and block-factorized calibration
sessions.boundary_reason: The hub-network benchmark produces a calibration artifact; a new sensitivity-DiD proposal follows.

sessions.topic: Sensitivity-DiD under independent-block shocks and a coverage contradiction

sessions.topic: Auditing within-block adoption and adopting joint Γ-block caps
sessions.boundary_reason: The revised assumptions are certified and adopted; the next proposal uses rollout instruments.

sessions.topic: Composite-null correction and deferral of rollout-IV at strength 0.2
sessions.boundary_reason: Corrected coverage comes at the cost of a full-range spillover bound; a stronger-instrument proposal follows.

sessions.topic: Certifying rollout-IV bounds at instrument strength at least 0.35
